in_sanskrit.name: माथि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is younger to the mother in the family. In extended families, it is common to have multiple siblings for each generation, and this term is used to denote the younger sister of the mother.

in_hindi.name: माथि
in_hindi.long_meaning: The younger sister of the mother. In large Indian families, it is common for there to be multiple generations, and this term is used to refer to the younger sister of the mother.

in_tamil.name: மாதி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The younger sister of the mother. In traditional Tamil families, it is common for there to be multiple siblings and generations, and this term is used to refer to the younger sister of the mother.

in_telugu.name: మాధి
in_telugu.long_meaning: The younger sister of the mother. In large Telugu families, it is common for there to be multiple generations, and this term is used to refer to the younger sister of the mother.

in_marathi.name: Mathi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mathi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Matru', meaning 'mother'. This name is associated with the goddess Matangi, symbolizing knowledge and wisdom. Mathi is a name for a girl endowed with great intellect and insight.
